text.en:
The Price Administration Board is hereby
authorized to fix the ceiling prices of commodities for the
different provinces of the Philippines by adding the trans-
portation and handling charges to the basic ceiling prices
fixed for the City of Manila and suburbs in accordance
with the zones herein established, as follows:
(a) For Zone No. 1 comprising the provinces of Bataan, Batangas,
Bulacan, Cavite, Cebu, Iloilo, Laguna, Mindoro (Oriental), Pam-

panga, Quezon, Rizal, Tarlac and Zambales, P0.01 per. pound or
fraction thereof.
(b) For Zone No. a comprising the provinces of Albay, Antique,
Bohol, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Capiz, Catanduanes, La
Union, Leyte, Marinduque, Masbate, Mindoro (Occidental), Negros
Occidental, Negros Oriental, Nueva Ecija, Pangasinan, Romblon,.
Samar and Sorsogon, P0.02 per pound or fraction thereof.
(c) For Zone No. s comprising the provinces of Augsan, Basilan,
Davao, Ilocos Sur, Lanao, Misamis Occidental, Misamis Oriental,
Mountain Province, Nueva Vizcaya, Surigao and Zamboanga, P0.03,
per pound or fraction thereof.
(d) For Zone. No. 4 comprising the provinces of Abra, Bukidnon,
Cagayan, Cotabato, Ilocos Norte, Isabela, Palawan and Sulu, P0.04
per pound or fraction thereof.
(e) For Zone No. 5 comprising the Province of Batanes, P0.05 per
pound or fraction thereof.

This Order shall take effect upon its promulga-
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of August, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
